title: Living Sketchbook App Coming March 20
content: I'm filming a promo for the soon-to-be-released "Living Sketchbook™" app. The app lets you explore one of my sketchbooks with high res pinch-to-zoom images, while enjoying immersive and informative audio and video content.Early reviewers are enthusiastic."This app is outstanding! One of my favorite aspects of your videos is getting the opportunity to hear your thoughts about the pieces you are painting. I love that I can get that same experience while enjoying the detailed views of the high-resolution sketches in the app.” —Jon Schindehette,Art Order"As a Beta tester I can assure all that this is a great app - like having Jim next to you as you flip through one of his sketchbooks. And more!"—Wade MeyersThe first volume of the app, "Boyhood Home" will be available March 20 for $4.99 for both iOS and Android phones and tablets.App coding and development by Dan Gurney.
